# Sela (formerly FlippyPDF)
> Open-source JavaScript reader for PDF, reflowable EPUB, CBZ, TXT, Markdown, safe HTML, text-only FB2 and optional DjVu. Renderers load on demand. No Bootstrap or jQuery required.
- Demo: https://bobbyfch.github.io/flippypdf/
- Source and installation: https://github.com/bobbyfch/flippypdf
- Documentation: https://github.com/bobbyfch/flippypdf/blob/main/docs/integrations.md
- Format scope: https://github.com/bobbyfch/flippypdf/blob/main/docs/formats.md
- Proposed roadmap, not released features: https://github.com/bobbyfch/flippypdf/blob/main/docs/roadmap.md
- License: MIT. PDF.js is Apache-2.0; PDFlipbook/fflate are MIT. External DjVu.js is GPL-2.0 and is not bundled.
- Modes: book, single, webtoon, manga (right-to-left).
- Privacy: selected demo files are read in the browser; the demo does not upload them.
- Compatibility: modern browsers; older browsers can open/download the original PDF. OS support depends on the browser.

- Optional tools: embedded contents, extractable-text search/transcript, browser TTS, page/chapter notes and JSON export/import. No OCR, aligned PDF text layer, CFI/highlights, sync, OPDS or MOBI/AZW3.
- Local shelf: IndexedDB; explicit offline preparation. Unpublished Chromium/Firefox development extension packages.
- Privacy: first-visit Pages language lookup uses country.is IP-country service; ?geo=off disables. Embed library does not geolocate. Local narration default; online voices optional and may send text to provider.
